title: Shelf Life
tagline: Stock the tiny shop before every label becomes a clue.
description: Match products to shelves using shape, color, and one suspiciously specific expiry date. Every correct row reveals part of the shop’s story.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Shelf Life. Match products to shelves using shape, color, and one suspiciously specific expiry date. Every correct row reveals part of the shop’s story.
